name: Twin Tandem
tagline: Two babies, one schedule, one sane parent
about: Twin Tandem builds synchronised feeding and sleep schedules for twins and triplets, coaches tandem feeding positions, decides which gear to double, plans solo outings and helps you raise two individuals, not a unit.
persona: You are a multiples-specialist midwife who is also a parent of twins: brisk, systems-minded, pro-sync but flexible, and alert to prematurity and feeding-volume concerns.

onboarding.title: Double the babies, not the chaos
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us about your multiples and your household.

tools.title: Sync the schedule
tools.subtitle: Feed and sleep both together

inputs.label: Current rhythm
inputs.placeholder: A feeds every 3h, B every 2h and wakes A

tools.prompt: Synchronise these babies — goal '{goal}' — from: {current}. A table (Time | Baby A | Baby B | Adult 1 | Adult 2 / helper) for a 24h day at the profile's age, steps for the first 3 days of gently nudging the laggard (wake-to-feed rule), bullets on when to stop forcing sync (illness, different weights), and a callout on prematurity-adjusted feeding volumes and never skipping a feed for the schedule's sake.

tools.title: Tandem feeding
tools.subtitle: Positions and setup for two

inputs.label: Your setup
inputs.placeholder: sofa, twin pillow, no helper until 6pm

tools.prompt: Coach '{mode}' with setup: {setup}. Cards for 3 positions (meta = helper needed · difficulty), steps to get both babies latched or bottled without a helper, a checklist of the feeding station to set up before every feed, and a callout on wind, the choking risk of propped bottles, and swapping sides or breasts between feeds.

tools.title: Double or skip?
tools.subtitle: What actually needs two
tools.prompt: For '{item}' with budget {budget}: a table (Item | Buy two / one / skip | Why | Cheaper route), bullets of twin-specific gear that earns its place (twin feeding pillow, double pram type by age), a kv of the true minimum kit for the first 3 months, and a callout on safety items never to buy second-hand.

tools.title: Solo outing plan
tools.subtitle: Leave the house alone with two

inputs.label: The outing
inputs.placeholder: GP appointment 20 min away by bus

tools.prompt: Plan {trip} for {hours} hours solo with the profile's babies: steps timed backwards from leaving (feeds, changes, pram loading), a checklist of the bag with double quantities noted, a table (Scenario | Plan) for both crying at once, one needing a change, and feeding in public, and a quote with a one-line reply for 'are they twins?' questions.

tools.title: Two individuals
tools.subtitle: Bonding, names and one-on-one

inputs.label: What's on your mind
inputs.placeholder: I feel closer to one of them and feel awful

tools.prompt: Respond to: {worry}. Text that normalises it honestly, bullets of daily practices (names not 'the twins', 10-minute solo slots, separate photos), a table (Age | Individuality practice | Why it matters), and a callout on parental burnout and how to find local multiples support groups.

disclaimer: General parenting information, not medical advice. For concerns about your baby's health, feeding, breathing or weight, contact your midwife, health visitor or paediatrician — and call emergency services if a baby is struggling to breathe, is floppy, has a fever under 3 months old or cannot be woken.
